page.heading: Licenses & prices
page.subheading: Prices start as list-price estimates. Enter what you actually pay per seat and month. Every impact figure recalculates from your numbers. There is no Microsoft API for tenant pricing.
page.adminHint: Changed rows show an enabled Save button. For many prices, use the bulk import below.
page.emptyHeadingFiltered: No matching Microsoft products in this section.
page.emptyMessageFiltered: Try a broader search or a different price status.

adobe.heading: Adobe products
adobe.description: Seat counts come from the Adobe Admin Console; Adobe publishes no price API, so enter your per-seat price to put a number on the offboarding leaks.

saas.heading: {label} products
saas.description: Seat counts come from the {label} connector; {label} publishes no price API, so enter your per-seat price to put a number on the findings.

bulkImport.heading: Bulk price import
bulkImport.description: Maintaining prices for many products or workspaces? Export the price book, fill in what you pay in a spreadsheet, and paste the result back here.

importForm.label: One product per line: key,monthly price. The key is an M365 SKU id or part number, or a connector key like adobe:Photoshop. Prices accept 14.90 and 14,90; unknown keys are skipped.
importForm.applied: Applied {count, plural, one {# price} other {# prices}}.
importForm.skipped: Skipped {count, plural, one {# unknown key} other {# unknown keys}}: {shown}{more}.
importForm.invalid: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} could not be parsed.

currencySelect.description: Changing currency converts prices, findings, trend history and renewal contract values using the latest ECB reference rate. Review negotiated prices afterwards.
